scope: Native production Observer controlled two-Euler-plus-camera mean mapping; all Riccati/gain/eigenvalue updates execute; fixed seed means and controlled truth conditional reference
source_contract: z0..2 corrected acceleration offset; z3..5 corrected gyro offset; identical physical offsets reused in both Euler steps. Point-1 bearing x/y perturbations 0.4*z0+z6 and 0.4*z3+z7; point-2 bearing x/y perturbations 0.2*z0-0.5*z6 and 0.3*z4+0.7*z7. Sources shared with IMU are the SAME Gaussian draw; z6..7 also shared across points.
production_config: LtvConfig defaults; only enable=true; production parameters/readiness unchanged
outputs: concatenate actual state after Euler step 1, Euler step 2, camera; joint cross-time/cross-point output
frozen_checks: FINITE and Observer never reset; FD step agreement reported; predict/sample covariance and full error covariance saved for every amplitude. No chi-square acceptance, no selecting one amplitude, no post-result threshold tuning.
fixed_gain_comparison: Capture nominal camera gains from existing shadow. Compare native full-map bearing finite differences (Riccati and gain perturbations included) against cameraSourceMap tangent prediction at nominal input. Preserve difference without assuming zero.
